fluff.overview: Motorized SCUBA laser platoons carry portable underwater propulsion gear and laser weapons modified for subsurface operation. The Federated-Barrett laser rifles and support lasers function in both air and water, giving these combat swimmers consistent firepower across amphibious transitions. The motorized sleds provide greater underwater speed and range than standard SCUBA troops can achieve, extending the platoon's operational reach for harbor infiltration, coastal sabotage, and subsurface reconnaissance missions.
